purpose: Optional accuracy/speed extensions and scoped deployment gates; not unfinished core work delegated to local

tasks.title: Hardware crossover policy
tasks.implementation: Use the implemented dense/structured full-cost campaign to calibrate dimension/horizon crossover. Polynomial choices require an optional new paired timing wrapper around the existing guarded action API; that wrapper is not already supplied. Preserve an abstain/default route until matched-error evidence admits a cell.
tasks.guarantee_or_conditional_benefit: No guaranteed wall-time benefit from degree or asymptotic order alone; a selected cell must have full-cost benefit.
tasks.acceptance: All arms pass accuracy and achieved-error matching; independent-process uncertainty excludes loss; separate uninstrumented timing from calibrated allocation runs.

tasks.acceptance: Full interval coefficient arithmetic and tube self-consistency; same11+101 output controls; fewer rejected/evaluated steps at matched error with setup charged.
